rows.what_the_ink_shows: Full scan inspected first, then crops/62_scan096_L831_dn_formula.png and crops/62_scan096_L831_preceding_formulas.png. The denominator of the dn fraction is sigma with a subscript consisting of one short upright stroke: sigma_1. The preceding sn and cn denominators have a curved subscript with a rightward lower foot: sigma_2. The cn numerator also has a short upright subscript 1, matching the target dn denominator.
rows.note: The original dn denominator sigma_1 matches the ink and is retained. The supplied correction proposes intended sigma_3/sigma_2, citing the p-to-sn relation and the squared quotient formula; that is an author-slip correction rather than a transcription repair. No independent mathematical proof was performed. The existing uncertainty immediately before the dn fraction and all unrelated notation, deleted marks and line breaks remain unchanged.
